requestBody.query: What's covered under the Manufacturer warranty?

200.answer: A new device's manufacturer's limited warranty covers defects and malfunctions. The manufacturer or authorized agents will repair or replace the product during this period. The warranty does not cover damage from misuse, accidents, liquids, or unauthorized modifications.

snippets.text: The manufacturer's limited warranty does not cover defects or damage caused by: improper storage damage from liquids unauthorized modification misuse neglect abuse accidents alteration improper installation abnormal operating conditions events outside of human control, such as natural disasters, for which no one can be held responsible. Mobile Internet device replacement: Your Mobile Internet device will be replaced with another when either in-warranty or out-of-warranty service is required. These devices will be exchanged in 24 to 72 hours (excluding weekends and holidays). Shipping times vary nationally. Out-of-warranty policy If your device requires a repair that is not covered by the manufacturer's limited one-year warranty, an out-of-warranty quote will be provided by the repair facility. If you choose to repair your device, you will be responsible for all fees. You will receive a 12-month warranty on the completed repair. If you choose not to repair it, your device will be returned at no cost. Find out more about repair service fees.
